verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents its own webhooks for change notifications: the developer site says you can receive notifications for any changes in Dropbox using webhooks, and there is a dedicated Webhooks API reference page. The pack does not show the signature verification or retry semantics the story asks for. missing for 10: documented request verification (e.g., signature/challenge handling), documented retry/delivery semantics, payload detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
